ayahs.1: Qasam hai raat ki jab chha jaaye.
ayahs.2: Aur qasam hai din ki jab roshan ho.
ayahs.3: Aur qasam hai us zaat ki jis ne nar-o-maada ko paida kiya.
ayahs.4: Yaqeenan tumhari koshish mukhtalif qism ki hai.
ayahs.5: Jis ne diya (Allah ki raah mein) aur dara (apne Rabb se).
ayahs.6: Aur nek baat ki tasdeeq karta rahega.
ayahs.7: To hum bhi us ko aasan raaste ki sahoolat denge.
ayahs.8: Lekin jis ne bakheeli ki aur be-parwaahi barti.
ayahs.9: Aur nek baat ki takzeeb ki.
ayahs.10: To hum bhi us ki tangi-o-mushkil ke saamaan mayassar kar denge.
ayahs.11: Us ka maal use (aundha) girne ke waqt kuchh kaam na aayega.
ayahs.12: Beshak raah dikha dena hamare zimme hai.
ayahs.13: Aur hamare hi haath aakhirat aur dunya hai.
ayahs.14: Main ne to tumhein shole maarti hui aag se dara diya hai.
ayahs.15: Jis mein sirf wohi bad-bakht daakhil hoga.
ayahs.16: Jis ne jhutlaya aur (us ki pairwi se) munh pher liya.
ayahs.17: Aur is se aisa shakhs door rakha jaayega jo bada parhezgaar hoga.
ayahs.18: Jo paaki haasil karne ke liye apna maal deta hai.
ayahs.19: Kisi ka is par koi ehsaan nahin ke jis ka badla diya ja raha ho.
ayahs.20: Balke sirf apne Parwardigaar-e-Buzurg-o-Buland ki raza chaahne ke liye.
ayahs.21: Yaqeenan woh (Allah bhi) anqareeb razaamand ho jaayega.
